echo._note: Returns the echoed message as prose text. No record structure to model.

get-annotated-message._note: Prose text for every messageType (error/success/debug all probed); annotations are envelope metadata, not payload.

get-env._note: Returns the launched process environment as a flat dict of str->str. Field names are machine-specific and include USER/HOME/PATH, so no TypedDict is emitted; the honest type is an untyped mapping.

get-resource-links._note: Returns resource_link blocks; mcpgen drops link metadata to str placeholders, so no payload shape was observed.

get-resource-reference._note: Both enum values of resourceType probed (Text, Blob) with resourceId 1 and 2; both returned the same list-of-3 text/resource blocks with no modellable payload. Discriminator resolved: no shape difference.

get-structured-content._note: The only tool on this server returning structured content. The server declares an outputSchema and mcpgen surfaced structuredContent directly, so no unwrap path is needed; the three scalars are typed as observed for location="New York".

get-sum._note: Returns the sum rendered as prose ("The sum of 2 and 3 is 5."); raw payload confirmed NOT_JSON.

get-tiny-image._note: Image tool: base64 bytes are deliberately dropped by the probe, so only the envelope was observed. Left as Any per the media rule.

trigger-long-running-operation._note: Returns a prose completion summary after the progress stream; no record.
